headline: BeyondTrust exploitation, exposed MSP credentials and a 10.0 Magento flaw
standfirst: Eight selected stories and two distinct CVEs. Confirmed exploitation, compromised credentials and tampered update channels feature among the critical patches and new exploitation research.
bodyMarkdown:
## Actively exploited

[[s18]] CISA says CVE-2026-102764, a critical authentication bypass in BeyondTrust Remote Support, is being actively exploited to gain initial access and establish persistence. NVD’s affected configuration reaches Remote Support 26.2.3 and earlier; patches are available for supported versions 24.3.1 and later, so older deployments must upgrade first. NVD scores the flaw 9.3 under CVSS 4.0 with CWE-290, network attack vector, and no privileges or user interaction required. CISA’s required action points to BOD 26-04 and forensics triage requirements; that federal requirement is not a universal deadline.

## Breaches

[[s4]] Unknown actors used a compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup credential to sign in to 173 Microsoft 365 tenants, according to researchers tracking an active campaign. The backup service is built for managed service providers, so customer M365 environments are in scope. No CVE is attached in the supplied intelligence.

[[s14]] Attackers repeatedly altered the files AOMEI Backupper fetched from its own update servers, in windows of five to ten minutes at a time, so Windows systems checking for an update during one of those windows would download and run a backdoor. The source describes repeated tampering over a multi-month period, not a single poisoned release.

## Vulnerabilities

[[s6]] CVE-2026-103849 is a maximum-severity 10.0 flaw in Magento and Adobe Commerce: an improper neutralization issue in a template engine, CWE-1336, that could result in arbitrary code execution. NVD says exploitation does not require user interaction and that scope is changed. The supplied KEV check is a confirmed catalog miss, which does not prove exploitation has not occurred, and researchers warn attackers could soon exploit it.

[[s1]] Drupal patched two critical remote-code-execution flaws affecting any supported version of the CMS and warned that exploits may emerge soon. No CVE identifiers were supplied for the pair, so they cannot be matched to NVD or KEV records here.

## Research

[[s13]] Candiru spyware reached devices at Al Jazeera Media Network through targeted online advertisements in zero-click attacks that required only rendering the malicious ads, according to the supplied report. The excerpt does not supply the underlying vulnerability or full delivery chain.

[[s2]] The malicious npm package imgdecode, tied to the MALFEX supply-chain campaign, hides a shellcode loader in a Windows native addon. It had been downloaded 979 times and remained available on npm at the time of the report.

[[s11]] Security firm Calif published a full local root exploit for OpenBSD 7.9 that chains a roughly 37-year-old integer overflow with a separate kernel flaw, bypassing KARL, SMAP and SMEP. The writeup and proof-of-concept code followed OpenBSD’s fixes.

kev.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
kev.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.
kev.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

nvd.description: The vulnerability exists within internal components of BeyondTrust’s Remote Support product. The components did not adequately validate the origin of the messages it received. Under the right conditions, this could allow an attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

selected.angle: CISA confirms active exploitation of the BeyondTrust Remote Support authentication bypass CVE-2026-102764 and sets an urgent patch deadline.

selected.title: Researchers Demonstrate OpenBSD Root Exploit Chaining 37-Year-Old Shared-Memory Bug
selected.excerpt: A local privilege escalation exploit published today gains root on OpenBSD 7.9 by chaining a roughly 37-year-old integer overflow with a separate kernel flaw, bypassing OpenBSD's KARL kernel-address randomization and its SMAP and SMEP hardware protections. Security firm Calif, which found and reported the flaws, published a detailed writeup and full proof-of-concept code after OpenBSD shipped
selected.angle: Researchers published a full OpenBSD 7.9 root exploit chaining a roughly 37-year-old integer overflow with a separate kernel flaw.
